what: DECIMATE_ABOVE_SIGMA re-validated at frame scale: exact vs decimated background estimation, per rung, per union, per candidate mask, scored against the hand-painted correction masks
why: the guard's only prior check is on 512 px tiles, where the rungs it governs are inert -- docs/figures/ladder_endpoints.json 'saturation' shows sigma=2560 moving 307 px in 6,815,744 against the rung below it
sigma40_shortcut: install()'s union uses the caller's exact flat when sigma == 40 (`f = flat if sigma == 40 else _flatten(img8, sigma)`), so the sigma=40 rung is never decimated at any threshold. Arms '32' and '64_shipped' are therefore the same computation on the shipped ladder; '32_no40shortcut' is the counterfactual.
scoring: correction masks: 1 = crack, 2 or 3 = not-crack, 0 = unreviewed
frame_selection: round-robin across specimens, up to 2 per specimen, NOT alphabetical

controls.shipped_closure_not_a_reimplementation: _flatten and the darkness cut are pulled out of detector_overrides.install()'s own closure and called directly

direction_key.fast_extra: pixels the decimated path marks that the exact path does not
direction_key.fast_missing: pixels the EXACT path marks that the decimated path does not -- the dangerous direction

cost_note: measured with WORKERS=6 concurrent frame processes on this machine; relative cost between arms is the usable quantity, absolute seconds are inflated by contention when WORKERS > 1
